product_overview: EntreAulas is a university evaluation platform focused on user authentication, password recovery, and admin-driven user management. The app supports role-based login flows, password reset requests, token-based password updates, and administrator creation of new user accounts.
core_goals: Log in with the correct user role and reach the appropriate dashboard
Request a password recovery link using an email address
Validate a recovery token and set a new password
Allow administrators to create new user accounts with the correct role and email domain

features.name: Login by user type
features.description: Users select their role, enter their credentials, and sign in to reach the dashboard assigned to that role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Choose a user type -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the role-specific dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Choose a user type -> Enter an invalid email format -> Submit the login form -> See the email format validation message
Navigate to /login -> Choose a user type -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the generic invalid credentials message
Navigate to /login -> Choose a user type -> Use the password visibility control while entering the password -> Submit the login form -> See the role-specific dashboard

features.name: Request password recovery
features.description: Users request a password recovery link by entering their email address on the recovery page.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter email address -> Submit the recovery request -> See the generic confirmation message
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter an invalid email format -> Submit the recovery request -> See the email format validation message

features.name: Validate reset token and set a new password
features.description: Users open a reset link, verify the token, and update their password if the token is valid.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password with a token and email in the URL -> See the token validation state -> Enter the new password twice -> Submit the password update -> See the password updated confirmation
Navigate to /reset-password with a token and email in the URL -> See the token validation state -> Enter two different passwords -> Submit the password update -> See the password mismatch message
Navigate to /reset-password without a token or email in the URL -> See the invalid or incomplete link message
Navigate to /reset-password with an expired or already used token -> See the invalid token message -> Request a new recovery link

features.name: Admin creates users
features.description: Administrators create new user accounts from the admin users page by entering identity details, role, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the add user form -> Enter first name, last name, username part, password, and user type -> Submit the user creation form -> See the new user appear in the users list

Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the add user form -> Choose a user type -> Observe the email domain update for that type -> Enter the remaining user details -> Submit the user creation form -> See the new user appear in the users list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the add user form -> Enter a weak password that does not meet the policy -> Submit the user creation form -> See the password policy validation message
Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the add user form -> Enter a username that is already registered -> Submit the user creation form -> See the duplicate email message
Navigate to /admin/users -> Search for the newly created user in the users table -> See the matching account in the filtered results

tech_stack: Express API on http://localhost:3000 (JWT, bcrypt, Supabase)

routes.description: Login page with user-type selector (Estudiante, Docente, Coordinador, Decano, Administrador), email and password (RQ2)
Request a password recovery link by email (RQ3.1, RQ4)
Validates ?token=&email= and lets the user set a new password (RQ3.2, RQ5)
Admin user management; "Agregar usuario" modal creates users (RQ1). Admin role only
Shown when a role opens a page it is not allowed to access

features.name: Login by user type (RQ2)
features.description: User picks a type, enters email and password; on success goes to the role dashboard. Wrong password, unknown email or inactive account show the same "Credenciales inválidas" message. Invalid email format shows "Por favor, ingresa un correo electrónico válido". After 10 failed attempts the API answers 429.
user_interactions: Open the user type selector and choose a type
Fill password input field and toggle "Mostrar contraseña"
See error message on invalid credentials or invalid email
Click "¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?" to go to /forgot-password

features.name: Admin creates users (RQ1)
features.description: In /admin/users the admin opens "Agregar usuario", fills nombre, apellido, usuario del correo (domain suffix depends on type), contraseña and tipo de usuario, and clicks "Crear". Password policy requires 8+ chars, upper, lower, number and special char. Duplicate email shows "El correo ya está registrado". Non-admin roles see "Acceso no permitido".
user_interactions: Fill nombre, apellido and usuario del correo
Choose tipo de usuario and see the email domain change
Search the new user in the users table

features.name: Request password recovery (RQ3.1, RQ4)
features.description: User enters an email and clicks "Enviar enlace de recuperación". Valid emails always get the same generic confirmation "Solicitud enviada" whether or not the account exists. If it exists, the API emails a one-hour link /reset-password?token=&email=.
user_interactions: See generic confirmation or invalid email error

features.name: Validate reset token and set new password (RQ3.2, RQ5)
features.description: On load validates the token. Missing token or email shows "El enlace de recuperación es inválido o está incompleto."; unknown, expired or used token shows "Token inválido o ya utilizado" with a "Solicitar un nuevo enlace" button. With a valid token the user types the new password twice and clicks "Actualizar contraseña"; mismatch shows "Las contraseñas no coinciden"; success shows "Contraseña actualizada". Tokens are single use.
user_interactions: Open the reset link with or without token

known_limitations.issue: A valid reset token only arrives by real email, so the successful RQ5 flow cannot be completed from the UI without mailbox access
known_limitations.impact: RQ5 success path can only be tested up to token validation

known_limitations.issue: Test scope limited to RQ1–RQ5; other routes (surveys, reports, QR, coordinator, dean) are out of scope
known_limitations.impact: Do not generate tests for other features

known_limitations.issue: The users table search box has only a placeholder and no label
known_limitations.impact: Locate it by placeholder "Buscar por nombre, email o rol…"
